summary.value: Ordinance amending the Health Code to prohibit tobacco retailers from selling flavored tobacco products, including menthol cigarettes. Finally passed by the Board of Supervisors on 6/27/2017 and approved by the Mayor on 7/7/2017 (Ordinance 140-17); a referendum petition was received, and on 9/5/2017 the Board's repeal action failed. Legistar lists the file's status as Failed.
